purpose: 为 eth_call stateDiff 覆盖 stETH shares/allowances 的存储槽推导依据（本轮固定区块模拟用）

contracts.name: StETH (Lido 实现合约 Lido.sol 的基类)
relevant_declarations: mapping (address => uint256) private shares;   // 行 68，常规 storage 首个变量
mapping (address => mapping (address => uint256)) private allowances;   // 行 73
bytes32 internal constant TOTAL_SHARES_POSITION_LOW128 = 0x6038150aecaa250d524370a0fdcdec13f2690e0723eaf277f41d7cae26b359e6;  // 非结构化槽，不占常规槽位

contracts.name: Pausable (StETH 的基类)
relevant_declarations: contract Pausable { using UnstructuredStorage for bytes32; ACTIVE_FLAG_POSITION 为非结构化常量 }
contracts.conclusion: Pausable 无常规 storage 变量；IERC20 为接口无 storage。因此 StETH 常规 storage 从 slot 0 开始：shares=0, allowances=1

onchain_validation.method: 读取 Curve 池在 stETH shares 槽的值，用 getPooledEthByShares 换算后与 balanceOf(pool) 比较
onchain_validation.result: 换算值 20365859942647003625932 == balanceOf(pool)，布局假设成立
